title: Rav Yaakov Zvi Marcus zt”l
body: Rav Yaakov Zvi (Jay) Marcus zt”l, founder of Yeshivat Reishit Yerushalayim, passes away. He was also Rabbi Emeritus of the Young Israel of Staten Island.

title: Swastikas Deface Shul
body: Shaarei Tzion kehillah's shul, led by Rav Moshe Gabay, targeted by hateful vandalism, including spray-painted swastikas. Police closed case despite identifying culprits.
